name: Sales Forecast & Inventory Prediction
author: devmdiqbal

sections.description:
Sales Forecast & Inventory Prediction helps WooCommerce store owners predict demand, optimize stock levels, and avoid stockouts or overstock. Features include:

  • Demand Forecasting – Product-level sales predictions using multiple models (Moving Average, Linear Regression, ARIMA, Prophet)
  • Inventory Insights – Reorder recommendations, stock-out risk, overstock analysis, dead stock detection
  • Alerts Center – Smart alerts for low stock, reorder points, and inventory health
  • Seasonality Analysis – Monthly heatmaps, year-over-year comparison, seasonal index
  • Reports & Export – Generate forecast, reorder, and stock health reports in CSV, Excel, or PDF
  • Scheduled Sync – Automatic sales data sync with configurable frequency

Requires WooCommerce 6.0+ and is compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).
sections.installation:
1. Upload the sales-forecast-inventory-prediction folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active
  4. Go to Inventory Forecast in the admin menu to complete onboarding
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin declares compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage.

What forecast models are available?

Moving Average, Weighted Moving Average, Linear Regression, ARIMA, and Prophet. You can select your preferred model in Settings.
